caption: The video captures a glass-fronted appliance with a metallic lower frame, viewed straight on from the front. Most cubes are pale cream or white, with a few brown ones near the center, and one isolated cube sits apart at the far left. Through and around the glass a kitchen is visible, with a dark table and chairs on the left, light cabinets and a hanging towel on the right, and a striped reflection plus a dark shape at the top center. The cubes and their arrangement appear unchanged, with no visible movement of the isolated left cube, the central brown cubes, or the cubes toward the right edge. The background and the glass reflections also appear stable, with no obvious pan, tilt, or zoom.
